A_tracking_v1_resolved.title: [Tracking] v1 semantic review: all 7 findings resolved
A_tracking_v1_resolved.body:
Tracking issue consolidating the 7 findings from the v1 semantic review (`.agents/tasks/task-digital-monster/2026-10-04-151615-review.md`, verdict NEEDS_CHANGES). All 7 are **already resolved** in the current implementation; this issue documents each with its resolution and can be opened and immediately closed as a record.

| # | v1 finding | Status | Resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Double-evolution stat rebase: `getMonster.ts` / `useMonster.ts advance()` ran a redundant second `evolveStage` after `applyTimePassage`, moving `stageId` without rebasing stats. | ✅ Resolved | Both call sites now call `applyTimePassage` only. Multi-stage catch-up lives in the private `applyAllEvolutions` in `packages/shared/src/game.ts`, which loops `evolveStage` (one step/call) and rebases stats via `applyEvolution` at every hop. No redundant second `evolveStage` anywhere. Verified present from backend commit 391d571. |
| 2 | Chat depends on persisted monster, ignores client `stageId`/`monsterName` (404 on first-ever chat). | ✅ Resolved | `chooseChatContext(loaded, request)` in `game.ts` uses the server record when present (anti-spoof) and falls back to client-sent `stageId`/`monsterName` otherwise, so a never-saved monster can still chat; `stageId` defaults to `baby` for unknown values. |
| 3 | Client-authored state trusted on save (no validation). | ✅ Resolved (scoped) | `validateMonster` deep-validates nested `stats`/`careCounters` and `stageId` before `putMonster`, rejecting malformed saves. Documented as client-authoritative-by-design (no auth); predicate guards structural integrity, not anti-tamper. |
| 4 | `removeUndefinedValues: true` masks malformed writes. | ✅ Resolved | Addressed together with #3: `validateMonster` rejects monsters missing required nested fields before they reach DynamoDB. |
| 5 | Battle can strand a monster at 0 HP with no revive path. | ✅ Resolved | `reviveMonster` (+ `REVIVE_HP_FRACTION`) restores a floor of HP (>=1) for a fainted monster; unit-tested. |
| 6 | No backend/infra automated tests. | ✅ Resolved (shared-logic coverage) | 42 `node:test` unit tests cover evolution AND-gate, immutability, time-passage, battle determinism/termination, revive floor, chat-context selection, and model mapping. Frontend pure helpers additionally covered in `game-ui.test.ts`. |
| 7 | CORS: API Gateway `corsPreflight` AND per-handler echo (two sources of truth). | ✅ Resolved | CORS centralized/kept consistent via `ALLOWED_ORIGIN`; preflight handled by shared `handlePreflight`/http helpers. |

Fixing commits/branch: resolutions are in the main feature-branch stack (shared+backend+frontend commits 139b6e4 / 391d571 / d7c42a2 and the review-driven follow-ups). No further code change required; closing as resolved.

C_ui_bugs.title: [UI] Battle log rendered raw English developer strings in the Japanese UI
C_ui_bugs.body:
**Severity:** medium

**Repro:**
1. Open the site.
2. Click バトル (⚔️ 野生のモンスターと戦う).
3. The battle log shows raw English developer strings verbatim, e.g. `T1: でじたん hits 野生の幼年期モンスター for 11 (enemy HP 7)`, `T1: ... hits でじたん for 2 (player HP 18)`, and `Result: player` — inconsistent with the otherwise fully-Japanese UI. (See artifact `.agents/tasks/task-digital-monster/artifacts/06-after-battle.png`.)

**Root cause:** `simulateBattle` in `packages/shared/src/battle.ts` emits English structured log lines (`T{n}:` / `hits` / `for` / `enemy HP` / `player HP` / `Result:`). The backend battle Lambda returns that log as-is and `packages/frontend/src/components/BattlePanel.tsx` printed each line verbatim. The winner headline was localized but the per-turn log underneath was untranslated English.

**Fix:** Added pure, unit-testable helpers in `packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts` — `winnerLabelJa(winner)`, `battleLogLineJa(line)`, `battleLogJa(log)` — that parse the deterministic structured log format with regexes and render Japanese (e.g. `1ターン目: {attacker} の攻撃！ {defender} に {dmg} ダメージ（相手/自分の残りHP {hp}）` and `結果: 勝利！/敗北…/引き分け`). Unrecognized lines pass through unchanged so nothing is dropped. `BattlePanel.tsx` now uses `winnerLabelJa` + `battleLogLineJa` and its local English-only `winnerLabel` was removed. Frontend-only change (shared/backend log format untouched), so no redeploy of the API was required.

**Verification:** 6 new `node:test` unit tests in `game-ui.test.ts` (12/12 pass); full `npm run build` exit 0; root `npm test` 42/42; Playwright re-run against the freshly built bundle shows the log fully localized (artifact `09-battle-localized.png`). Only remaining Latin token is the game term `HP` inside `残りHP`, consistent with StatsPanel.

**Fixing commit/branch:** `fix/ui-playwright` @ **9759bc8** 'fix(frontend): localize battle log to Japanese'.
